items.title: Stremio Origin 2.0 Ultra
items.text: A major update: a second player, voice search and the film's own frame rate on Google TV, faster addons everywhere.

items.title: Every film plays
items.text: On Google TV, VLC takes over by itself for any file, picture or sound the TV can't play: from the same point, your language kept.

items.title: Search by voice
items.text: On Google TV, press Search on your remote in Search, or the microphone key, and say a title in English or Arabic.

items.title: Picture in step, sound everywhere
items.text: The screen follows the film's frame rate when Match content frame rate allows it. Dolby and DTS sound from any speakers.
